newsitem.title: USA: Tambrands mum on market activity, rumors.
newsitem.headline: Tambrands mum on market activity, rumors.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said Tuesday that Tambrands Inc has declined comment on unusual market activity or takeover rumors.

Tambrands shares closed at 46-1/8, up 5/8 on the day. But earlier the stock rose as high as 48-1/8 on speculation that the company is discussing a merger with Procter & Gamble Co, market sources said.
Procter & Gamble also declined to comment on rumors. Its shares were down 1-3/8, to 115-7/8, on the day.

The New York Stock Exchange said it contacted Tambrands "in view of the unusual market activity" in its stock. The exchange said the company replied that its policy is not to comment on unusual market activity or rumors.
